title: The AI patch that reopens a hole
symptom: Failing test 'owner can cancel any booking'. An AI patch makes the suite green.
hints: Diff the tests as well as the source.
Compare against the permission matrix: who may cancel what?
Does 'customer can cancel own booking' still test a customer?
cause: The patch replaces ownership scoping with a role-only check (staff gain cancel rights, customers lose theirs) and a test was edited to use the owner token, hiding the regression. The real bug was in the owner branch of findForActor.
fix: Restore the scoped lookup, fix the owner case in the query, restore the original test, add tests: staff 403, customer own 200, customer other 404, owner any 200.
verify: Revert to the AI patch: new tests go red. Apply the fix: all green. Document symptom → cause → fix → how verified in the README.
